name: Consider identity and access management for your service (ORR 16)
source: Identity Management B2B,Identity Management B2C,Identity Management B2E
conditionsText: If a service requires users to securely access the service or information
requirementTitle: Consider identity and access management for your service (ORR 16)
requirementDescription: Enable users to securely access the digital services and information they need while protecting departmental data and systems.
why:
- provide a consistent and secure user experience in your service or product
- reduce the number of identities and passwords users need to manage
- improve security through modern authentication and authorisation controls
- enable services to adopt common departmental identity standards and platforms
- reduce duplication of effort and technology across services
